At eprint.ae, we supply custom printed magnetic wall sheets in Dubai — self-adhesive panels that install directly onto any flat wall surface. Available in plain magnetic, whiteboard-magnetic (writable) and branded printed options with your logo, office colours or custom graphics. Ideal for modern offices, collaborative workspaces, schools, universities, hospital wards and creative agencies. The writable option combines a dry-erase whiteboard surface with full magnetic functionality — a dual-purpose solution for agile, modern work environments across Dubai and the UAE.

🏆 Key Features

  • ✔ Turns any wall into a magnetic surface
  • ✔ Self-adhesive, easy-install panels
  • ✔ Plain, whiteboard or branded print options
  • ✔ Writable dry-erase option available
  • ✔ Available in any custom dimension
  • ✔ Ideal for offices, schools & creative spaces

📋 Material / Substrate Options

  • ✔ Flexible magnetic sheet with adhesive backing, dry-erase coating optional

✨ Finish Options

  • ✔ Plain magnetic, whiteboard magnetic, printed magnetic

💼 Ideal Use Cases

  • ✔ Offices, schools, hospitals, co-working spaces, creative agencies
